"A threaded cgroup cannot have domain controllers in its subtree_control. When a cgroup becomes threaded, all domain controllers are removed from its subtree_control."

But here, `/sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.subtree_control = "cpu pids"` AND `cgroup.type = threaded`. This is contradictory! The kernel shouldn't allow a threaded cgroup to have domain controllers in subtree_control.
